result:
I’ll check the Gemini and LiteLLM stream converters, fix their tool-call indices, and add focused regression tests. I’ll follow the repository’s Python style skill.
Both paths match the reported bug. Gemini needs a counter scoped to each stream; LiteLLM needs to retain the supplied index, including zero. I’m adding coverage for Gemini calls across chunks and LiteLLM’s interleaved argument fragments and fallback behavior.
Implemented both fixes:

- Gemini assigns consecutive tool-call indices across chunks, resetting for each stream.
- LiteLLM preserves supplied indices, falling back to chunk position when the index is missing or `None`.

Added regression tests for parallel calls, interleaved arguments, and fallback behavior. All 125 tests in the two provider files passed, but pytest exited with an error because its teardown process inspection was blocked by sandbox permissions.

The two out-of-scope issues remain unchanged.

+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_gemini_chat_stream_parallel_tool_call_indices():
+    provider = GeminiProvider(EndpointConfig(**chat_config()))
+    payload = chat.RequestPayload(**chat_function_calling_payload(stream=True))
+    parts_by_chunk = [
+        [{"text": "Looking up weather"}],
+        [
+            {"text": "Calling tools"},
+            {"functionCall": {"name": "get_weather", "args": {"location": "Paris"}}},
+            {"functionCall": {"name": "get_weather", "args": {"location": "London"}}},
+        ],
+        [{"text": "One more city"}],
+        [{"functionCall": {"name": "get_weather", "args": {"location": "Tokyo"}}}],
+    ]
+    responses = [
+        f'data: {json.dumps({"candidates": [{"content": {"parts": parts}}]})}\n\n'.encode()
+        for parts in parts_by_chunk
+    ]
+    # Reusing a provider must start a fresh sequence for each request.
+    for _ in range(2):
+        mock_client = mock_http_client(MockAsyncStreamingResponse(responses))
+        with mock.patch("aiohttp.ClientSession", return_value=mock_client) as mock_build_client:
+            chunks = [chunk async for chunk in provider.chat_stream(payload)]
+        mock_build_client.assert_called_once()
+        mock_client.post.assert_called_once()
+
+        calls = [chunk.choices[0].delta.tool_calls or [] for chunk in chunks]
+        assert [[call.index for call in chunk_calls] for chunk_calls in calls] == [
+            [],
+            [0, 1],
+            [],
+            [2],
+        ]
+        assert [
+            json.loads(call.function.arguments) for chunk_calls in calls for call in chunk_calls
+        ] == [{"location": "Paris"}, {"location": "London"}, {"location": "Tokyo"}]

+from types import SimpleNamespace
 from unittest import mock
 
 import pytest
@@ -1196,3 +1197,53 @@ async def test_chat_passes_stored_base_url_through_when_upstream_protection_is_o
         await provider.chat(chat.RequestPayload(**payload))
 
     assert mock_completion.call_args[1]["base_url"] == "https://custom-api.example.com"
+

+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "index_fields",
+    [[{"index": 1}, {"index": 0}], [{}, {}], [{"index": None}, {"index": None}]],
+)
+async def test_chat_stream_tool_call_indices(index_fields):
+    expected_indices = [fields.get("index") for fields in index_fields]
+    expected_indices = [i if index is None else index for i, index in enumerate(expected_indices)]
+
+    async def mock_stream():
+        for arguments in ['{"city":', '"Paris"}']:
+            calls = [
+                SimpleNamespace(
+                    **fields,
+                    function=SimpleNamespace(name="get_weather", arguments=arguments),
+                )
+                for fields in index_fields
+            ]
+            # Explicit indices must survive even when each call arrives alone.
+            batches = [[call] for call in calls] if index_fields[0].get("index") == 1 else [calls]
+            for batch in batches:
+                yield SimpleNamespace(
+                    id="chunk-1",
+                    object="chat.completion.chunk",
+                    created=1234567890,
+                    model="test-model",
+                    choices=[
+                        SimpleNamespace(
+                            index=0,
+                            finish_reason=None,
+                            delta=SimpleNamespace(tool_calls=batch),
+                        )
+                    ],
+                )
+
+    provider = LiteLLMProvider(EndpointConfig(**chat_config()))
+    payload = chat.RequestPayload(messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Weather?"}])
+    with mock.patch("litellm.acompletion", return_value=mock_stream()) as mock_completion:
+        chunks = [chunk async for chunk in provider.chat_stream(payload)]
+    mock_completion.assert_called_once()
+    calls = [call for chunk in chunks for call in chunk.choices[0].delta.tool_calls]
+    assert [call.index for call in calls] == expected_indices * 2
+    arguments_by_index = {}
+    for call in calls:
+        arguments_by_index[call.index] = (
+            arguments_by_index.get(call.index, "") + call.function.arguments
+        )
+    assert arguments_by_index == {0: '{"city":"Paris"}', 1: '{"city":"Paris"}'}
